videos.title: Linear — brand film

color: fully monochrome
typography: small light italic phrases, blur-fade per word
shape_language: precise 3D geometry: spheres, cubes, rings
character_humor: none; people only as a tiny crowd

videos.signature: Slow tweens with long deceleration, blur as a tool, light-based transitions, logo built by a slide-reveal.

music.summary: Ambient score with no clear beat (pulse 0.16, almost no percussion); the light-flash transitions follow the copy, not the music.

videos.title: OpenAI — brand film

typography: editorial bursts with big glyphs and rotated words, but never deformed

character_humor: none

videos.signature: A single dot carries the film; snap + micro-settle instead of tweens; construction lines → solid; human-cadence typing.

music.summary: ~96 BPM pulse with moderate percussion; the fast layout bursts sit loosely on the beat (33% of cuts on beat vs 22% by chance, 43% on half-beats); shots last ~1 beat.

videos.title: Health care consumers — explainer

videos.title: OpenToscana — explainer

typography: a few bold sans labels; icons and speech bubbles replace text
shape_language: flat vector, rounded and friendly; clean geometry plus organic landscape
character_humor: characters carry the story; gags (chair roll-in, light bulb idea, rocket)

videos.title: AchX Studio — launch-video service promo

secondary_motion: heavy motion blur, ghost echoes and smears on type, slight wobble on chat bubbles; no springs or squash
color: black/white type and UI; color only in inserts (lilac 3D renders, logo color strobe, warm rocket footage)
typography: thin grotesk but big kinetic moments: scattered letters assembling 'Unicorns', full-width smeared words, typing
shape_language: precise UI pills and type mixed with soft claymorphic 3D and dithered organic clouds
character_humor: one toon character gag, chat banter, cursors with name tags acting on words, 'Post & Praying' wit

videos.signature: Monochrome one-statement type cards linked by motion-blur smears, with chat UI, named cursors and one-beat inserts of 3D renders and AI footage.

music.summary: Soft 117.5 BPM bed with a weak pulse (0.24); cuts land on the beat at chance level (23% vs 27%), shots run about one bar, and the loudest music (49-54 s) sits under the quiet logo cards: the edit follows the copy, not the beat.

videos.family_note: Between 01 Elegant · Editorial (mono palette, thin type, one statement at a time) and 02 Playful reel (gags, smeared letters, strobes, media mixing). Filed as 02 because of the tone (5.5) and the jokes; energy 5.0 sits at the low edge of the Playful zone. The media mixing (toon, 3D, AI footage) also echoes 04, but without collage texture or camera travel.

videos.title: Vercel Ship LDN — brand/event sizzle

secondary_motion: almost none: shots are near-still frames cut fast; only the mascot blinks and a few drifts
color: black and white throughout (colorfulness 5.5); rare accents: red wireframe globe, blue Geist plate, gradient beam, colored charts
typography: big type moments from the brand system: Geist Serif with highlight bars, particles forming 'PIXEL', full-frame 'If it's agentic it's on Vercel'
shape_language: precise geometry, pixel grids, triangles, circuit boards; one liquid drip as the organic exception
character_humor: the boxy robot mascot with '||' eyes, police lights and blinks; claw-machine gag

videos.signature: A fast black-and-white montage of brand-system frames, product UI, 3D objects and event photos, each held a fraction of a second, resolved by a stepped logo build.

music.summary: Clear 99.4 BPM pulse (0.66) but cuts land on the beat below chance (15% vs 23%) and shots last a median 0.72 beats: the cuts run faster than the beat and ignore it, while the macro shape (quiet intro, louder sections from ~20 s and ~40 s, decay under the logo) follows the music.

videos.family_note: Restrained tone (4.0) and monochrome discipline put it in 01 Elegant; the change-by-snap grammar is closest to Editorial (ref02). It differs from the existing Elegant refs by its montage density (60 cuts/min, cut-driven rhythm) and the event/brand sizzle format, hence a proposed sub-style. Could also be read as a calm-toned showreel.

videos.title: motionmaxxing — agent skill type teaser

secondary_motion: motion blur on every slide and 2–4 f RGB-split glitches; no overshoot, no idle loops
color: dark navy plate, light grey type, one coral accent per card; cyan/magenta only inside glitches; colorfulness 20.3
typography: type is the whole cast: bold keyword cards, words joining into the product name, spec annotations (weight, tracking, easing) over the word; not deformed
shape_language: precise guide lines, baselines, brackets and a drawn easing curve
character_humor: wit in the copy: 'looksmaxxing', 'AI slop.' set in a dull default serif as the bad example

videos.signature: One statement per card on a still dark plate; blurred slides with strong ease-out in / ease-in out, RGB-split glitches between ideas, and designer spec annotations drawn over the type.

music.summary: Soft 89 BPM bed with a weak pulse (0.37); no cuts and motion bursts land on beats less than chance (14% vs 21%): the edit follows reading time, not the beat.

videos.family_note: Restraint, one statement at a time, short copy, still holds, mono + one accent, clean landings without overshoot: Elegant core rules. Glitch punctuation and tech-meme copy push it toward a darker, edgier sub-style than Cinematic (no 3D/light) or Editorial (no snaps); proposed 'Dark type teaser'.

videos.title: aratama 'KAMI CIRCUIT 神回路' — vertical trailer

secondary_motion: glitch slicing, RGB split, strobe dropouts, datamosh/pixel-sort, manga speed-line bursts and screen shake; no springs or squash
color: saturated vermilion + black + white throughout, cyan as second accent, a blue/violet outro; limited palette but loud (colorfulness 39)
typography: kanji and Latin words fill the frame, sliced, extruded in 3D, glitched and split across cards (KA / MI / CIR / CUIT); manga SFX katakana
shape_language: precise HUD grids, circles and wireframes against organic fractal 3D architecture and hand-drawn manga speed lines
character_humor: no characters; manga onomatopoeia (ドンッ, ゴゴ) and a speech bubble give it a comic wink

videos.signature: Vertical cyber-Shinto trailer: a slow HUD build (mandala push, torii tunnel, wireframe core) drops at 12.4 s into a 0.3–0.7 s card montage of sliced kanji, manga speed lines and fractal 3D, framed by a persistent HUD with timecode and BPM.

music.summary: 137 BPM electronic track (the HUD even prints '137.14 BPM'), clear pulse 0.61; the build is cut-free for ~28 beats, the montage starts on the beat at 12.4 s, then cuts follow the busy rhythm (dotted-eighth runs of 0.76 beat) rather than the quarter-note grid: overall cuts on beat 24% vs 32% chance.

videos.family_note: High energy (7.7, cut-driven montage) and expressive tone (7.0) put it in the Playful reel zone, but the mood is epic/gritty, not playful. Proposed sub-style 'Cyber-HUD montage'; if more references like it arrive, the family name 'Playful reel' may need to become 'High-energy reel' or this becomes its own family. Two-part structure (flow build → cut-driven drop) is also notable.

videos.title: Claude, motion designer — self-promo reel

secondary_motion: back-out (17% overshoot), elastic and bounce shown explicitly; heavy motion-blur smears on type, stretched letters, particle sparks on the logo burst
color: coral, electric blue, acid lime, cream and black, a new flat color per section; colorfulness 59
typography: frame-filling extended black caps (EASE / IN. / OUT. / NEVER / LINEAR.) that smear, stretch, bounce per letter and tile into a repeating pattern
shape_language: precise geometry (circle → triangle → star → square morphs, dot sphere) mixed with organic truchet curves and a hand-drawn spark mark
character_humor: wit through the subject: 'Six ways to get from A to B', 'EASE IN. EASE OUT. NEVER LINEAR.'; no characters

videos.signature: A motion designer's manifesto: each section demonstrates a principle (easing lanes, shape morphs, pattern, 3D dots) on a new flat color, then cuts on eighth notes into frame-filling smeared type that spells 'EASE IN. EASE OUT. NEVER LINEAR.'

music.summary: 129 BPM track with a clear pulse (0.51); the edit is locked to it: section cuts land on beats 4 and 8 beats apart, the type finale cuts every half beat then every beat, and the easing demo moves last exactly 2 beats (~0.93 s).

videos.family_note: High energy (6.1) and expressive tone (8.0): squarely in the Playful reel zone. The content is self-referential (a demo of motion principles), so it doubles as a reference for the library's own token vocabulary.

videos.title: Helium browser — UI update teaser

secondary_motion: anticipation shrink (~19%) before the zoom-through, motion blur on the logo spin, ~2% overshoot; no bounce
color: one brand blue with soft white light gradients, then near-white UI; colorfulness 54 comes from the single saturated blue
typography: small clean sans wordmark and 'Update' line; the only play is 'UI' letters closing into a boxed icon
shape_language: precise UI chrome and a geometric asterisk mark, softened by blurred light blobs
character_humor: none

videos.signature: Brand-blue logo intro (wordmark slides out from the asterisk, 'UI' snaps into an icon), the asterisk spins in huge, breathes in and zooms through to an app tile, then a white-out reveals the browser and the camera glides into the new tab sidebar.

music.summary: No audio track in the file: pacing follows the visual build only (holds of ~1.1 s median between moves).

videos.family_note: Restrained, single accent color, one idea at a time, clean landings, logo built on screen: Elegant core. Not Cinematic (no dark/3D light) nor Editorial (no snaps); it's the typical SaaS/app 'product UI' launch look, proposed as sub-style 'Product UI'. Cuts part of energy (6.9) is inflated by flashes/white-outs counted as cuts; real hard cuts are ~2.

videos.title: Blueprint — iPod patent / x-ray sizzle

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; only film grain boiling on every plate and on-twos stepping
color: saturated electric blue, x-ray blue/black and a thermal yellow/green LUT; strong but one treatment per section
typography: almost no type: labels inside patent drawings and a small blackletter wordmark at the end
shape_language: precise technical linework and x-rays, roughened by grain and mixed with handheld footage
character_humor: no characters; hands in footage and a witty 'show the product through its patents' device

videos.signature: The iPod told through its patent drawings and x-rays: grainy blueprint-blue plates, stepped camera moves on twos and a 3-frame strobe montage, cut faster than the music.

music.summary: 103 BPM groove with a fairly clear pulse (0.62) but the edit ignores it (cuts on beat 14% vs 24% chance, median shot ~0.6 beats); the loudest hits land on the still end plates.

videos.family_note: Mixed media: collage of footage, archive drawings and scans with heavy texture and color treatments, cut-driven. Not Elegant (grain, saturated blue, frantic cutting) nor Playful (no springs, no kinetic type). Differs from ref04 (2.5D camera flow) by being cut-driven with stepped moves; could justify a 'technical/archive collage' sub-style.

videos.title: 1984 (Orwell) — typographic zoom-through trailer

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; stamps hit without bounce; only slow pushes and light sweeps
color: desaturated low-key palette (colorfulness 17) with a single red accent
typography: big heavy-serif statements built word by word, zoomed through as transitions; not deformed or bouncing
shape_language: photographic/organic scenes plus crisp serif type and rectangular stamps
character_humor: silhouetted figures and a watching eye carry a story, but no acting or humor

videos.signature: One lowercase heavy-serif statement per moody still, built word by word, then an accelerating zoom-through into a letter or the eye carries it out to the next scene.

music.summary: No clear beat (pulse clarity 0.10, ambient/score-led); cuts and accents ignore the grid, the only aligned hit is the stamp slam at 0.2 s, and pacing follows a regular ~2 s phrase cadence.

videos.family_note: Elegant · Cinematic in restraint (desaturated, no springs, one statement at a time, smooth camera) but with editorial big type and a grim, gritty mood; the photo/still imagery with stamps and redaction marks also leans toward Mixed media. Proposed sub-style 'Cinematic editorial'.

videos.title: Osmo Studio — word-per-shot launch teaser

secondary_motion: no springs or overshoot; backgrounds loop on their own (particles, HUD boxes, ink growth) while the type is still
color: saturated neon and posterized backgrounds on a near-black base; varies shot to shot
typography: one tiny lowercase grotesk word, centered, never animated
shape_language: organic blobs, ink smoke, doves, particles and light forms, plus some precise UI
character_humor: no characters; a dry line ('without the slop') and silhouettes

videos.signature: A tiny, motionless centered word over a new animated visual every 1.083 s: the sentence is read across metronomic cuts, then the hero visual reappears inside the product UI.

music.summary: 107.7 BPM low-percussion bed with a fairly clear pulse; the edit cuts on a metronomic 1.083 s clock (~2 beats at 110.8 BPM), so cuts drift across the beat instead of locking (on beat 25% = chance, on half-beat 67%).

videos.family_note: A showreel of the tool's possible outputs, cut to a regular rhythm, saturated and varied: Playful reel in intent, but at mid energy (4.4) and with deadpan tiny type and no springs. Could also sit in Mixed media (footage + generative + UI), but it lacks texture/collage layering. Proposed sub-style 'Minimal word-per-shot showreel'.

videos.title: Payy — fintech brand identity film

secondary_motion: no overshoot measured; smear/motion blur on the logo build and glitch distortion on type, no springs or idle loops
color: restricted palette: black, white/grey and acid lime, with a violet photo accent
typography: big bold condensed statements, giant 'PRIVATE' wiping behind a flying card, glitch-distorted letters, distorted display wordmark
shape_language: precise UI pills/cards and cards in 3D, plus an organic scribble/smear logo build
character_humor: no characters or humor (a hand holding a phone, a badge photo)

videos.signature: Black and acid-lime fintech identity: a scribbled smear resolves into the app icon, which shrinks into the UI; pills morph into cards, giant type wipes behind a flying card, and the identity closes on a run of page-peel transitions.

music.summary: 143.6 BPM low-percussion track (pulse 0.40) that kicks in at ~3.3 s, one beat after the logo icon lands; overall cuts on beat = chance (33%), though several mid-film scene changes sit within ±0.15 beat; the music fades from ~29 s under the page-peel montage and the end card plays over silence.

videos.family_note: Elegant core (restricted palette, product UI, clean ease-outs, no springs, one statement at a time) pushed toward Playful by bold type moments, glitch letters and a fast page-peel montage. Mid energy 5.0. Proposed sub-style 'Bold tech brand'; could also be read as a bridge between Editorial and Playful reel.

videos.title: Hyundai i10 — #i10inside game teaser

secondary_motion: confetti and balloon bursts, flapping birds, banners that unfold and flutter, flash pops; but camera and truck moves are smooth tweens with no visible springs (wipes overshoot <=2%)
color: saturated flat backdrops that switch per beat of the story: teal, mustard yellow, steel blue, coral, plus orange/red accents
typography: folded paper ribbon banners with condensed italic type that writes on with a smeared streak; big 'READY?' / 'GO!' / countdown badges; not deformed
shape_language: low-poly faceted papercraft world (folded paper water, hills, buildings), toy trucks; geometric but hand-made feel
character_humor: a shell-game premise ('Follow this truck!', 'Which one?', 'Bingo!'), two small scooter riders taking flash photos; props carry the wit, characters are secondary

videos.signature: A toy-like low-poly papercraft world where white trucks play a shell game, framed by paper-ribbon banners that write on with smeared streaks and separated by quick diagonal color wipes.

music.summary: 117.5 BPM track with a moderate pulse (0.45); the edit is loosely beat-aware (cuts on beat 40% vs 27% chance, on half-beat 47%), the dense onset passage (0-8 s) matches the title build, and the long 28 s camera flight runs over a steadier, quieter bed.

videos.family_note: Playful reel by tone (saturated colors, game premise, banners, confetti) but energy 5.2 sits at the edge of the zone because most of the film is one long smooth camera flight (Flow), not fast cuts or springs. Its 3D low-poly papercraft look is new: proposed sub-style '3D papercraft toy world'. Could also be read as a Character-family piece in 3D, but characters are minor.

videos.title: Film Brazil — retro infographic explainer with a Brazil mascot

secondary_motion: letters hop in arcs and settle, scattered letters assemble, sparkles and ribbon waves on holds, a dancing mascot; overshoot visible on sheets but not measured
color: saturated retro 5-color palette (mustard, teal, burnt orange, navy, cream) used throughout; one or two colors dominate per scene
typography: type is the main cast: giant numerals with ordinals, mixed retro faces (slab, script, stencil), letters fly, bounce and assemble, words become wipes
shape_language: precise flat geometry (circles, diamonds, bars) softened by paper grain and a rubber-hose mascot
character_humor: Brazil-shaped mascot with sunglasses walks, dances and plays scale gags (giant shoe) at start, middle and end; most of the film is data

videos.signature: A Brazil-shaped rubber-hose mascot bookends a fast parade of retro kinetic statistics in which every number, letter or coin grows into the wipe that opens the next fact.

music.summary: No usable beat (129 BPM detected but pulse clarity 0.14, percussive share 0.37); cuts on beat 20% vs 30% chance and median shot ~5 beats, so pacing follows the phrase/fact structure (likely narration-led), not the music.

videos.family_note: Placed in 03 Character because a mascot carries the opening, a mid section and the ending and the tone is expressive (7.5) at mid energy (3.8), inside the Character zone. Doubt: ~70% of screen time is kinetic infographic typography, closer to a missing 'kinetic infographic explainer' sub-style (could also sit under 02 Playful reel at lower energy). Retro paper grain hints at 04 but there is no collage or footage.

videos.title: PNC Bank "Teamwork" — 30 s brand spot

secondary_motion: follow-through and overlapping action on limbs, pendulum swings on rings, arcs on jumps; no squash on objects or type
color: several colors throughout (teal, burgundy, orange, slate blue, olive) but muted on a cream ground
typography: the word TEAMWORK is the set: each giant letter is an obstacle-course structure; letters are not deformed or kinetic themselves
shape_language: hand-made props (wood grain, ropes, nets, trees, a deer) on geometric extruded letters; elongated stylized figures
character_humor: characters are the story: climbing, pulling each other up, high-fives, swinging, a relay toward a finish flag

videos.signature: A slow, constant camera truck along the word TEAMWORK built as a playground, cutting letter to letter while stylized figures help each other through it, then a pull-back reveal of the whole word and the logo.

music.summary: 136 BPM with a moderate pulse (0.51) and very low percussive share (0.10); cuts and accents lean slightly toward the beat (40% / 47% vs 32% chance, only 10 cuts) and the music builds to its peak around the TEAMWORK reveal at 24 s, then decays under the logo.

videos.family_note: 03 Character: characters acting and helping each other carry the message, like ref05. Different look from ref05 (dimensional letters, cream background, elongated figures, no section colors) and a calmer edit (continuous trucking camera, one letter per shot), so a sub-style is proposed. Typography is the environment, which links it to typographic brand films.

videos.title: CEAL — Energy integration event opener

secondary_motion: almost no springs (emblem slide ~2% overshoot); motion comes from camera drift, rotating orbit rings, swaying pumpjacks and a Newton's-cradle loop
color: restricted palette: dusty steel blue / navy base with orange and yellow accents, plus paper/grain texture
typography: large condensed all-caps questions and a letterspaced 'COMBUSTIBLES FÓSILES' title; calm builds, no kinetic deformation
shape_language: flat geometric vector (pylons, turbines, rigs, arrows) softened by grain, soft gradients and low-poly hills
character_humor: one small worker character appears briefly; otherwise objects and infographics only

videos.signature: A widescreen (4:1) flat-vector essay on Latin American energy in steel blue and orange: the camera drifts through layered parallax landscapes of pylons, turbines and rigs, punctuated by orbiting rings and big quiet questions.

music.summary: 129 BPM bed with a weak pulse (0.27) and low percussive share (0.23); only 8 hard cuts and the edit is independent of the beat (37% on beat vs 30% chance), with long shots (median 5.4 beats); the busiest onset stretch (44-58 s) overlaps the denser infographic section.

videos.family_note: Elegant by restraint (restricted palette, one statement at a time, long holds, clean long ease-outs, energy 3.7, tone 4.0), but illustrated and 2.5D with texture, which pulls it toward 04 Mixed media's camera-flow-through-layers. Proposed sub-style 'Illustrated 2.5D editorial'. Doubt: tone 4.0 is at the Elegant upper bound.

videos.title: Volkswagen “Think Blue” (Sehsucht) — monochrome 3D city brand film

secondary_motion: no springs or squash; bubbles draw on and fill without visible overshoot; only small character gestures and puddle ripples
color: a single blue tint over the whole 3D world plus black/white silhouettes; colorfulness 52.7 comes from the saturated blue, not from many hues
typography: no type until the end card 'Think Blue.' in small light-cyan type, then the VW logo with 'Das Auto.'
shape_language: precise low-poly 3D architecture and cars, contrasted with organic flat silhouettes
character_humor: silhouette people act out small everyday scenes (commute, coffee, a girl stepping in a puddle) with thought-bubble icons; gentle wit, no gags

videos.signature: A single-blue 3D city seen through an almost unbroken flying camera, where flat black-and-white silhouettes live small everyday moments and white thought-bubble icons appear beside them.

music.summary: Clear but non-percussive pulse at 99 BPM (pulse 0.63, percussive share 0.02, enters ~10 s); the edit ignores it (cuts on beat 23.5% vs 23.2% chance, median shot ~3.8 beats) and the camera keeps moving through it.

videos.family_note: 01 Elegant · Cinematic: 3D space, continuous camera travel, monochrome palette, restrained secondary motion and almost no type (tone 3.0). Energy 5.7 sits just above the Elegant zone only because the camera is always moving (motion part 9.5); cuts and speed parts are mid. Doubt: people are present throughout, so it touches 03 Character, but they are flat silhouettes with small acting, not a character-led story.
